_comment: Top-loading appliance (converted with --extra-rot-x -90 so the lid is on TOP, hinged at the back-top edge pivot (0,0.207,0.097), axis x). Base AABB x+-0.146 y+-0.217 z[-0.154,0.108]; lid is a thin top panel z[0.094,0.154]. Hollow housing: floor + 4 side walls, OPEN TOP. Walls top out at z=0.085 (just below the lid underside z=0.094) so the lid can flip up without catching them, and so objects can be placed inside.
